thesis: The page is a cut list: every section is a numbered cut on the sheet, headed by a dimension line with ticks, and the signature is the kerf mark that grows as you scroll toward the finished joint.

signature.name: Cut List + Kerf Rule
signature.summary: Horizontal dimension-line primitive with left/right ticks and mono label 'CUT NN · PART · DIMS · SPECIES'; kerf width grows via --sw-p; reused in hero, rot story, trim cards, footer.

palette.family: Harbor Teal + Clapboard Cream + Oxide Red + Brass

motion.intro: Pencil line draws hero dimension rule L→R; filmstrip slides in frame-by-frame with cut counter 00→06; ≤1.2s skippable.
stories: Pinned scarf-joint SVG draws/glues on scroll
Cut rules wipe in via clip-path with number count-up
motion.hover: Hairline kerf grows from left via scaleX under cut rules and cards
